keyCharacteristics: One accent, used as a signal
Hairlines and tonal panels instead of shadows

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Green appears only as a signal (dot, number, hover, focus). It never fills a region or a button.

rules.name: The Mono Metadata Rule
rules.body: Anything that is data about content is mono and muted; content itself is never mono.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box shadows anywhere; a border colour change is the hover state.
